perks.name: Old Contacts
perks.flavor: Somebody's cousin always knows somebody. Be somebody's cousin.
perks.note: start each city at +1 rank (max R3 start)

perks.name: Kept Man
perks.flavor: He gets a window seat and a new name. He keeps the old habits.
perks.note: one chosen specialist survives Skip Town (slot per level)

perks.name: Traveling Light
perks.flavor: One suitcase. Half of it is singles.
perks.note: Pocket Money auto-clean scales with city #

perks.name: Reputation Precedes You
perks.flavor: They heard what happened to the last guy. They start the meeting nervous.
perks.note: first Commission boss of each city starts at phase 2

perks.name: The Stash
perks.flavor: A locker at the bus station, under a name the Feds already retired.
perks.note: begin each city with 5% of previous city's clean cash (dirty, ha)

perks.name: Double Life
perks.flavor: You left town. The rent did not.
perks.note: previous city's idle income keeps flowing at 10% (stacking cities = the empire never really resets)

perks.name: The Big Sleep
perks.flavor: He goes out on top, in bronze, still watching the ball.
perks.note: retire a maxed specialist forever → he becomes a patron-saint statue on all future tables: a small aura zone with his power at half strength, always on

perks.name: Museum of Crime
perks.flavor: Every job leaves one thing you cannot sell. Put it under glass.
perks.note: unlocks the relic gallery: heist relics socket into set bonuses (3 Museum pieces = permanent +1 casino edge, etc.)

perks.name: Fast Learner
perks.flavor: The second time through, you know which doors open inward.
perks.note: ☆ requirements −20% in cities you've beaten before

perks.name: The Golden Era
perks.note: unlock the Golden Ball tier in every city at T5 instead of T7

perks.name: Silent Empire
perks.flavor: The machine hums while you sleep. It hums in two colors.
perks.note: offline Safe cap doubles AND fills with 10% clean directly

perks.name: The Sixth Family
perks.flavor: Five cities sit down at one table. Somebody has to pour.
perks.note: New Game++: all five cities' Commissions rolled into one repeatable gauntlet table (post-launch content hook)
